# std/result
Represents operations that can succeed or fail.
Use instead of exceptions for type-safe error handling.

Pure functions (no effects required)

## Types

  [2mThe Result type: Ok(value) or Err(error)[0m
  export type Result[a, e] = Ok(a) | Err(e)

## Exports

  map[a, b, e]((a -> b), Result[a, e]) -> Result[b, e]

  mapErr[a, e1, e2]((e1 -> e2), Result[a, e1]) -> Result[a, e2]

  flatMap[a, b, e]((a -> Result[b, e]), Result[a, e]) -> Result[b, e]

  isOk[a, e](Result[a, e]) -> bool

  isErr[a, e](Result[a, e]) -> bool

  unwrap[a, e](Result[a, e]) -> a
    Unsafe: crashes on Err; document in README.

## Usage

  import std/result (map)
  -- or --
  import std/result as Result

ok: CREDIT(50)
err: insufficient_funds
ok: CREDIT(150)
ok: DISPENSING(25)
err: busy
ok: IDLE
err: no_credit
ok: CREDIT(100)
ok: DISPENSING(25)
ok: IDLE
